title: Casting Types
instructions: Sometimes you need to change a value from one type to another. That's called casting.
Put the type you WANT in parentheses in front of the value: (int)someDouble.
Important: turning a decimal into an int CHOPS off everything after the dot. It does NOT round. (int)3.99 gives 3, not 4.
Casting makes a converted copy — the original variable is unchanged.
Read = right to left: 'displayScore GETS a copy of testScore, converted to an int.'
task: Fill in the cast so displayScore becomes 95 and the output shows:  displayScore = 95
hint:
Cast the double to an int:

    displayScore = (int)testScore;
